stem.text: A transverse progressive wave travels along a string.
The graph shows the variation with distance of the displacement of the string at time $t = 0$.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis displacement and horizontal axis distance, origin 0, showing a wave-shaped curve. Labels: direction of travel of the wave, P, distance, displacement.

stem.text: Which graph represents the variation with time of the velocity of point P on the string?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis velocity and horizontal axis time, origin 0. A horizontal straight line above the time axis.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis velocity and horizontal axis time, origin 0. A line made of straight segments that rises and falls above and below the time axis.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis velocity and horizontal axis time, origin 0. A smooth wave-shaped curve starting at the origin, above the time axis and then below it.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis velocity and horizontal axis time, origin 0. A smooth wave-shaped curve starting below the time axis and ending above it on the right.
